_about: Standing authorization for autonomous fiction production. Claude Code runs the full workflow (series -> cast -> script -> paid media -> render -> QC -> canon) without stopping for human approval, but never above these caps, never uploading, never buying credits.

format._about: Measured runtime incl. any titles/credits. produce-episode stops after the voice track (before image spend) if outside min-max; QC fails the master outside it.

assets_policy: Only original AI-generated media: locked bible references (fal FLUX 2 Flash), motion shots from the configured fal reference-to-video model, fal lip-sync, ElevenLabs roster voices from bible/voices.json, and owner-licensed or AI-generated music/SFX with provenance. No stock, web, celebrity, franchise or real-person imagery.
never_automatic: deleting outputs or canon (exception: after approve, a story-folder episode's own manifest-listed scratch files are removed, per the owner's 2026-11-21 production brief)

music.ai_provider: ElevenLabs Music (music_v2_5), 900 credits/min, counted in max_voice_credits

director._about: Deterministic motion-first pipeline (director.py). Money caps are NOT set here: the director uses episode_caps and monthly_caps above. Only the owner changes caps.

qa._identity_note: Disabled 2026-11-22: Apple Vision feature-print distance did not separate people in the pilot (same person 0.76-1.00, different person 0.92-1.20). Identity is checked in the frame review.

director._lipsync_mode_note: native = the motion model (Seedance 2.5 reference-to-video) lip-syncs to our ElevenLabs line passed as @Audio1 in the same call (works with FAL_KEY alone). post = separate fal lip-sync endpoint (Sync Lipsync 2.0) on the motion clip; needs fal-client for CDN uploads.
